name: UFC Undisputed Forever
summary: UFC Undisputed Forever is a community-driven overhaul of UFC Undisputed 3 that brings the classic MMA experience into the modern era. It replaces the original cast with over 60 current-day UFC fighters and swaps the game's PRIDE mode for a RIZIN Fighting Federation mode with a broadcast-style presentation overhaul, alongside updated fighter attires, gloves, canvases and championship belts.
